hatchloop/readiness.summary: Writes to AgentBroker's own lead funnel and stops there: this tool does not notify the business or update its CRM. Needs a supply-network smb_id (from import_booking_url); an osm:... id is refused.

description: Structured intake of a prospect into an SMB's funnel with validation and deduplication on (smb_id, phone or email). Stored in AgentBroker's own lead funnel, NOT the business's CRM; the business is not notified. [$0.05/per_call, not charged while no payment rail is on] [async→get_outcome] [beta]

idempotency_key.description: Retry key: a 24h replay returns the original receipt, not re-run or charged.

consent_record_id.description: Optional ID of a consent record proving the prospect asked to be contacted (e.g., they filled an SMB's intake form or requested a quote). Required when downstream send_message calls are anticipated.

name: capture_lead
